out_of_scope_advisories.detail: Two of the six spec domains carry TWO slugs across the corpus: data-science-knowledge-and-creative (12 docs) vs -creative-work (5), and collective-intelligence-and-meta (17) vs -meta-workflows (9). workflow-dsl.schema.json types `categories` as a bare slug array with NO enum, so nothing rejects either form, and the two sibling testkits disagree about which is canonical - bp2_common.SPEC_CATEGORIES pins the long pair, bp4_testkit.SPEC_CATEGORIES pins the short pair, and each unit's tests assert its own. A consumer grouping by category sees EIGHT buckets, not six.
out_of_scope_advisories.action_taken: None to the documents. 11 of the 13 drifted files belong to sibling units; rewriting the 2 that are mine would leave two spellings in place while manufacturing the appearance of consistency, and would put my documents at odds with 3 sibling documents in the same design family. Instead bp8_testkit.CATEGORY_ALIASES normalises the drift for this unit's span assertion so it cannot false-negative on a spelling, and the conflict is reported here.
out_of_scope_advisories.owner_or_orchestrator_decision: pick one slug per domain and add an enum to workflow-dsl.schema.json#/properties/categories so the drift cannot recur

Recommended as an orchestrator-owned follow-up, with _bp8b_orphan_gates.py (which already carries its both-states control) as the reference implementation.

unverified_inline: That any of these twelve blueprints RUNS is UNVERIFIED and unverifiable today: no DSL runner exists. Every test in this unit asserts a DECLARED property of a document (a gate's expression, a dependency edge, a barrier's reject list, a convergence bound), never runtime behaviour. Settling experiment = build the runner and replay one recorded journal per blueprint; until then a green suite here means 'the definition says the right thing', not 'the workflow does the right thing'. Each document states the same limitation in its own x_extensions.unverified.

The measured evidence each blueprint cites from the design library (the four-stacked-failures CI incident, the 1,188-file/316,222-deletion stale branch, the 681-green-in-both-apply-orders case, the 3-versus-28 repo count, the 19-day-dead recall index) is QUOTED, not re-measured by this unit. Settling experiment = each document's own benchmark_cases block, which names the reproduction for its case.

bp8_testkit imports its generic half from bp4_testkit, a sibling unit's module. If that sibling reshapes it, these suites fail loudly via test_bp8_testkit_dependency_is_present_and_shaped rather than silently measuring nothing - but the coupling is real and is disclosed here rather than hidden behind a try/except fallback, because a fallback that behaves slightly differently is the both-states hazard this program exists to avoid.
residual: Nothing in range 85-96 is unmeasured. Open items are all outside it: the 3 red foundry tests (a sibling's fixture), the two-spelling category drift (needs one orchestrator decision plus a schema enum), the missing orphan-gate rule in wfdsl.semantics (a shared instrument), one non-blocking orphan gate in a sibling document, and BP-MNT-06 needing a slot. The one defect found inside range - an unenforced blocking gate in slot 89 - is fixed, revalidated, and guarded by two tests with mutation controls.
